<entry id="K00744">
<head-word>כָּלִיס</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, pl. כְּלִיסִים, כְּלִיסִין (כלס, enlarg.</definition>
<notes> of כל; cmp. Ges. H. Dict.
<sup>10</sup> s. v. כרשׂ) 
<italic>bags</italic>. Tosef. Kil. V, 26 אהולין והכ' הגרגים וכ' ed. Zuck. tents and bags, filters &c., v. אכסלי.—Trnsf. 
<italic>pods, a dehiscent fruit</italic>, similar to carob. Ter. XI, 4 כ' וחרובים 
<italic>k’lisin</italic> and carobs; Ukts. I, 6 כְּלוּ' (Maim.: a species of 
<italic>figs</italic>, v. כְּלוּפְסִין).—Ḥull. 67
<sup>b</sup> (a species of 
<italic>peas</italic>, Rashi); Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 10, ch. XII, a. e. יתושין שבכ' the bugs found in &c.; Y. Ter. VIII, 45
<sup>b</sup> bot. Tosef. Ter. V, 7; Y. Bicc. III, beg. 65
<sup>c</sup>; a. e.—[Ukts. III, 2, v. בּוּלְבּוֹס. Y. Maasr. II, 50
<sup>a</sup>, v. כְּלוּפְסִין.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

Fr. כליסריקים, corr. acc.) this refers to their (the Roman) chiliarchs; Yalk. Deut. 944 כלירקין.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00749">
<head-word>כַּלָּךְ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="K00275">כּוּלְכָא</xref>) 
<italic>cissaros-blossoms</italic>, a woolly substance, v. אַגְבִּין.</definition>
<notes> Kil. IX, 2, expl. Y. ib. 32
<sup>a</sup> top אגבין קיסריי. Sabb. II, 1. Ib. 20
<sup>b</sup> היינו כ' this (metaxa) is 
<italic>kallakh</italic>. Ib.; Men. 39
<sup>b</sup> השיראים והכ' וכ' (garments of) silk, 
<italic>K</italic>. &c. (v. סְרִיקִין). Sabb. 27
<sup>a</sup>. Tosef. ib. IX (X), 3 צמר כ' 
<italic>Kallakh</italic> wool. Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. V, 11 כולך ed. Zuck. (R. S. to Kel. XXVIII, 8 כלך).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00750">
<head-word>כַּלֵּךְ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (contr. of כַּלֵּה וָלֵךְ, v. 
<xref rid="K00690">כָּלָה</xref>) 
<italic>cease and turn!, go!</italic></definition>
<notes> Yeb. 44
<sup>a</sup> כ' אצל שכמותך turn towards one corresponding to thine own age. B. Mets. 22
<sup>a</sup> כ' אצל יפות go to better fruits (to take T’rumah from); Erub. 71
<sup>a</sup>. B. Bath. 164
<sup>b</sup> כ' מלשון וכ' turn away from this kind of slander. Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 2, ch. II או כ' לדרך זו or turn this way, i.e. I may argue thus; (ib. Emor, Par. 12, ch. XVII או לכה וכ'). Ib. Vayikra, Ḥobah, Par. 7, ch. XI או כ' לך (corr. acc.); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00751">
<head-word>כִּלְכּוּל, </head-word>
<head-word>כִּילְ', </head-word>
<head-word>כַּלְכָּל</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (כִּלְכֵּל) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>hair-crown</italic> (cmp. כְּלִילָא), 
<italic>front hair</italic> from temple to temple.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. VIII, 4 (78
<sup>b</sup>) כדי לעשות כ' (Bab. ed. כלכל; Ms. M. כדי לסוד כי', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) enough to produce a crown by depilation of undergrowth. Ib. 80
<sup>b</sup>, v. אַנְדִּיפֵי. Naz. 3
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Mish. I, 1 הריני מכלכל) how do we know דהאי כ' שערו הוא that this vow refers to letting the hair grow?—Nidd. 52
<sup>b</sup>; Tosef. ib. VI, 6 (ref. to the hair around the pudenda as evidence of maturity) כ' זה איני יודע (מהו) about this 
<italic>kilkul</italic> I know nothing.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>support, sustenance</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Naz. l. c. אימא מיזן עניי I may say that the 
<italic>kilkul</italic> (of the Mishnah, v. supra) means supporting the poor.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00752">
<head-word>*, </head-word>
<head-word>*כַּלְכּוּס</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (χαλκός) 
<italic>a copper, caldron</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 100
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Mish. IX, 4 צבאו כעור) [read:] מאי כעור … שצבעו כ' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50) what does, ‘he dyed it 
<italic>ka</italic>
<italic>ʿ</italic>
<italic>ur’</italic> mean?… the copper dyed it (cmp. הקדיח' היורה ib.); מאי שצבעו כ' כפרא דודי (Ms. H.) what does it mean &c.? The sediment of kettles. [Editions a. Mss. have כלבוס, קלבוס with ב].—
<plural-form>Pl. כַּלְקִין</plural-form>. Y. B. Bath. IV, 14
<sup>c</sup> bot. בסלקי, (read: בית כלקין, corresp. to בית היורות Tosef. ib. III, 3) the copper room.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00753">
<head-word>כַּלְכִּיד, </head-word>
<head-word>כַּלְכִּידָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (χαλκίς, -ίδος) 
<italic>chalkis</italic>, a small fish resembling sardines (v. Sm. Ant. s. v.).</definition>
<notes> Y. Ned. VI, 39
<sup>c</sup> bot. if one says, I will taste no דָּגָה, אינו … אלא בכ' he is forbidden ony 
<italic>ch</italic>. (small fish). Ib.
<sup>d</sup> top כיל' אנא טעים I feel as if I were eating 
<italic>ch</italic>.—Ib. לית … והוא זבין ליה כ' is it not often the case when a man says to his neighbor, buy me a fish, that he will buy 
<italic>ch</italic>. for him?—Y. Erub. III, 20
<sup>d</sup> top כלבודא (corr. acc.); Y. Peah VIII, 21
<sup>a</sup> top (סלק') כלקורא, read: כַּלְקִידָא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00755">
<head-word>כִּלְכֵּל</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="K00758"> כלל</xref>,
<xref rid="A00083"> כול)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to surround</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to provide with everything; to sustain</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Naz. 3
<sup>a</sup>, v. כִּלְכּוּל. Ber. 58
<sup>b</sup> וכ' אתכם בדין וכ' and provided for you (while alive) in justice, and gathered you in justice.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. כְּלִילָא) 
<italic>to raise a crown of hair, to be a nazir.</italic></definition>
<notes> Naz. I, 1 הריני מְכַלְכֵּל I will grow a crown (as a substitute for, ‘I will be a 
<italic>nazir</italic>’, v. כִּינּוּי). Y. ib. 51
<sup>b</sup> top כאומר הריני מן המְכַלְכְּלִין as if he said, I will be one of those who wear a crown of hair.—Tosef. Nidd. VI, 6; Nidd. 52
<sup>b</sup> עד שתְּכַלְכֵּל (euphem.) until she has a full growth of hair (around the pudenda).—</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>*3)</number>
<definition> denom. of כֶּלִי) 
<italic>to arm, fit out</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. VII א"ל הקב"ה ולא אני כלכלתי בה (read: כִּלְכַּלְתּיו) said the Lord to him (Doëg), is it not I that fitted him (David) out with it (the sword of Goliath deposited in the Sanctuary)?—[The entire sentence is missing in ed. Bub.; note 69 a. l. quotes fr. mss. קלקלתי.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nithpalp.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְכַּלְכֵּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be supported</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 4 אליהו נ' וכ' (not נתבלבל) Elijah was supported by the woman of Zarephath.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K00757">
<head-word>כַּלְכָּלָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced. art.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>support, provision</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 44
<sup>a</sup> על המחיה ועל הכ' (be blessed &c.) for sustenance and support.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>supply</italic>, esp. 
<italic>basket containing chosen fruits</italic> designated for use.</definition>
<notes> Eduy. IV, 10 (9); Maasr. IV, 2 כַּלְכָּלַת שבת supply of fruits for the Sabbath (not for sale). Ib. הלוקט הכ' וכ' he who selects figs to send as a present. Y. ib. IV, 51
<sup>b</sup> כ' שבת אינה וכ' Sabbath supply must not be sold. Y. Ter. II, end, 41
<sup>d</sup> תאינים שבכ' figs in the provision basket, opp. מוּקְצֶה. Y. Dem. I, 21
<sup>c</sup> bot. כ' אחת וכ' there is only one basketful (of the late fruits) which I reserve &c. Lev. R. s. 33, beg. כ' של תאנים a basket of figs for use (subject to tithes even for luncheon, v. טֶבֶל); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. כַּלְכָּלוֹת</plural-form>. Dem. VII, 6; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00758">
<head-word>כָּלַל</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="K00259">כּוּל</xref>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to surround, comprise, include</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 4 חזר וכְלָלָן כולן וכ' (not וכללו כולו) he again included them all in the praise (Gen. I, 31). Shebu. 23
<sup>b</sup>
<pgbrk id="pg644" />בכוֹלֵל המותרים וכ' when he (in his vow) includes permitted things as well as forbidden things. Ib. 24
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. איסור כולל, v. אִיסּוּר. R. Hash. IV, 5 וכולל מלכיות עמהן and inserts that section of prayers concerning the divine rulership, v. מַלְכוּת; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. כָּלוּל, f. כְּלוּלָה a) 
<italic>included</italic>. Y. Pes. V, 32
<sup>c</sup> bot. ירידת גשמים כ' וכ' the praise for the rain-fall is included therein (Ps. CXXXV, 7); Y. Taan. III, 67
<sup>a</sup>, end.—Y. Ber. I, 3
<sup>c</sup> top עשרת הדברות כְּלוּלִין בהן the Ten Commandments are contained therein.—b) 
<italic>entire</italic>, v. כָּלִיל.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to generalize</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="K00758">כְּלָל</xref>).</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 63
<sup>a</sup> חזר (הדר) וכ' the text generalizes again.—[Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44
<sup>b</sup> top טוחנין … כוללין, read: כּוֹבְרִין, v. כָּבַר.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִכְלָל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be implied, to be stated in general terms</italic>, opp. נפרט.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sot. VII, 21
<sup>d</sup> top דברים שנִכְלָלוּ ונפרטו things which have been stated both implicitly and specifically.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>כִּילֵּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to crown</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. R’eh 7 אם נוצחין … ומְכַלְּלִין אותו when they (the legions) are victorious, they come and make a wreath, and crown him (the king).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to include, imply.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<italic> Part. pass</italic>. מְכוּלָּל, 
<plural-form>pl. מְכוּלָּלִים</plural-form>
<italic>enclosed</italic> (as a germ), 
<italic>potential</italic>. Gen. R. s. 10 (ref. to ויכלו, Gen. II, 1) מ' היו המעשים things had been created potentially, and then they developed more and more.—[Y. Ber. VI, 10
<sup>a</sup> top יכללו, read: יִבָּלֲלוּ, v. בָּלַל.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִכְלִיל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to crown, finish, perfect</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Part. pass, מוּכְלָל. Yoma 54
<sup>b</sup> (expl. מכלל, Ps. L, 2) מציון מ' יופיו וכ' from Zion the beauty of the world was perfected (by religion). [Cant. R. to V, 11, end מוכללת, read: מוּבְלֶלֶת, v. בָּלַל.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K00759">
<head-word>כְּלַל</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to surround, crown</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. Cant. III, 11.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of כּוֹלָּא) 
<italic>to make whole, combine</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Meg. IV, 75
<sup>b</sup> bot. לינן חזרין וכָלְלִין לון do we not again combine them (the separated portions)?</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>כַּלֵּיל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to surround, crown</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. Ps. V, 13.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="K00532">כִּילָה</xref>, 
<xref rid="K00557">כִּילְתָא I</xref>) 
<italic>to prepare a bridal room</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 101
<sup>b</sup> כַּלְּלֵיה לבריח if the owner of the rented dwelling gave it to his son as a bridal room (Rashi: if he was making preparations for his son’s wedding, and needed the dwelling for the young couple). Gen. R. s. 70; Yalk. Gen. 125 כולי יומא הוו מְכַלְּלִין (ביה) ליה the whole day they were helping him to prepare the bridal chamber (decorating it).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַכְלֵיל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to crown, surround</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. LXV, 12. Ib. CIII, 4; a. e.—[Kidd. 81
<sup>b</sup> מכלליה, read: מכלי להו, v. כְּלֵי I.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיתְכַּלֵּל, אִיכַּלֵּל, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיכְּלִיל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be crowned, to adorn one’s self</italic>.</definition>

<entry id="K00760">
<head-word>כְּלָל</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced. wds.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>general rule, principle</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra K’dosh., Par. 2, ch. IV (ref. to Lev. XIX, 18) זה כ' גדול וכ' this (‘love thy neighbor as thyself’) is the most important principle in the Law. Sabb. VII, 1. Ḥull. III, 1 זה הכ' this is the general rule; a. v. fr.—Trnsf. בִּכְלַל, לִכְלַל 
<italic>under the influence of</italic>. Sifré Num. 157 לפי שהיה בכ' כעס בא לכ' טעות because he was under the influence of anger, he came under the influence of mistaken judgment; Yalk. ib. 786; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>community</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 49
<sup>b</sup> לעולם אל … מן הכ' a person must never exclude himself from the community (by saying, ‘Praise ye’, instead of ‘Let us praise’). Mekh. Bo., Pisḥa, s. 18 ולפי שהוציא … מן הכ' וכ' and as he excluded himself from the community (by saying ‘you’) &c.; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>total, sum</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 123
<sup>a</sup> בכְלָלָן אתה וכ' as their sum total you find seventy (Gen. XLVI, 27), whereas the detailed record counts only sixty nine.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>generalization, statement by implication</italic>, opp. פרט specification; 
<italic>inclusion, comprehension under a class</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 26
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. עד ועד בכ', v. עַד.—Sifra introd. מכ' ופרט מפרט וּכְ' וכ' interpretation based upon a general law followed by specification, or specification followed by generalization. Ib. כל דבר שהיה בכ' וכ' when a law is once laid down in general, and in another place a specification is given (e.g. Lev. VII, 37, a. ib. 20), it is stated specifically not for its own sake alone, but as applicable to the whole class. Ib. beg. מכ' ופרט וּכְ' אי אתה דן וכ' if a general rule is followed by a specification and this again by a generalization, you must be guided by the specification (e.g. Deut. XIV, 26). Tosef. Sot. VIII, 10; Sot. 37
<sup>a</sup> ברוך בכ' … ארור בכ' וכ' ‘blessed be’ was pronounced on Mount Gerizim in general (corresp. to the general curse, Deut. XXVII, 26) and was specified (corresp. to ib. 15—2</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>5)</number>
<definition>; ‘cursed be’ was pronounced on Mount Ebal in general (ib. 26) &c.; a. fr.—מִכְּ' 
<italic>by implication</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ned. 11
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. מכ' לאו אתה שומע הן from 
<italic>no</italic> you understand 
<italic>yes</italic>, v. הֵן.—Pes. 16
<sup>b</sup> שהותרה מִכְּלָלָהּ וכ' which was permitted (dispensed with), by implication, for a community (if unclean, derived fr. Num. IX, 2, v. Pes. 77
<sup>a</sup>). Ḥull. 37
<sup>b</sup> מכ' דטרפה וכ' this proves by implication that 
<italic>t’refah</italic> is not the same as &c.; a. v. fr.—לאו … כ' 
<italic>not at all</italic> (cmp. כְּלוּם). Ib. 20
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—[Mekh. Bo, beg. כ' לדברות, read: כֶּלִי.]—
<plural-form>Pl. כְּלָלוֹת</plural-form> (
<italic>fem</italic>.). Naz. 48
<sup>b</sup>. Sot. 37
<sup>b</sup>. Erub. 27
<sup>a</sup> אין למדין מן הכ' וכ' from general rules (the use of the word כל, as ib. III, 1) we must not derive anything, not even when an exception is stated (as there may be other exceptions); a. fr.—Ex. R. s. 32, beg. כְּלָלִים.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>yabam</italic> nor after having been taken to his house.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (of a sore) [
<italic>to gather</italic>,] 
<italic>to grow smaller, to contract</italic>, opp. פשה.</definition>

<sense>

<number>—2)</number>

<italic>to form a recess</italic> or 
<italic>settle</italic>.</definition>

<number>—2)</number>

<italic>pudenda</italic>). Yeb. 4

<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>cover</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup>; Pesik. R. s. 12; Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 11 (ref. to יִכָּנֵף, Is. XXX, 20) … כל זמן כ' מכסה וכ' as long as the seed of Amalek survives, it is as if a cover hid the face (of Divinity) &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (
<italic>pl.</italic>) 
<italic>hands, arms</italic>; (of animals) 
<italic>shoulders, fore-legs</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup>) ראשי כ' the cartilaginous tops of the fore-legs. Y. Naz. VI, 55
<sup>c</sup> bot. (ref. to Num. VI, 19) בין שיש לו כ' וכ' whether or not he has hands (to receive the offerings; Bab. ib. 46
<sup>b</sup> כַּפַּיִם). Tosef. Dem. II, 11 מקבלין לכ' we accept a 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>aber</italic> (v. חָבֵר), if he promises to observe levitical cleanness of hands; Bekh. 30
<sup>b</sup>. Y. Dem. II, 23
<sup>a</sup> top מקריבין לכ'. Ib. כ' מדפות וכ' the laws concerning hands, &c., v. מִדָּף.—אלישע בעל כ' one Elisha, a 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>aber</italic> observing cleanness of hands. Y. Ber. I, 4
<sup>c</sup> bot.; Sabb. 49
<sup>a</sup>; 130
<sup>a</sup> (legendary origin of the surname).—Lev. R. s. 32 בעל כ' the winged angel.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>curved attachments, handles</italic> &c. Kel. XI, 6; Tosef. ib.</definition>

<italic>divine protection</italic>; תחת כ' הש' under the wings of divine Majesty, i.e.

R. s. 26 מְכַסָּה אני ממך shall I conceal it from thee?—Gen. R. s. 87 כִּסְּתָה פניה she covered her (the idol’s) face.
